title: Harborside
wikitext:
'''Harborside''' is a [[neighborhood]] of [[Kingsport]].  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. The Harborside [[street]] area is an [[aquatic location]].

==Locations==
*[[607 Water St.]]
*[[North Point Lighthouse]]
*[[The Rope and Anchor]]
